references.text: The Lord's command that Aaron should be gathered to his fathers on Mount Hor, which Moses now obeys
The direct command from the Lord to take Aaron and Eleazar up Mount Hor
Moses later received a similar command to go up a mountain in the sight of the people
Summary that Aaron went up Mount Hor by the Lord's command and died there
Reference to Aaron's death on Mount Hor, where he was gathered to his people
Moses and Aaron did as the Lord had commanded them - a recurring theme of obedience
Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him - the same formula of obedience
